name: QrFormatInfo
src_typeComment: Format info: 15 bits (2-bit EC level + 3-bit mask pattern, then a 10-bit BCH(15,5) error-correction code, then XORed with a fixed mask) written twice into the matrix so a scanner can recover it even if one copy is damaged/occluded (ISO/IEC 18004 section 8.9, Annex C). This is GF(2) binary polynomial division — a DIFFERENT, simpler math than the GF(256) Reed-Solomon used for the actual data, since format/version info uses its own dedicated BCH code, not Reed-Solomon. Public (not internal) specifically so the Editor-folder self-test — a different default assembly in this no-asmdef project — can call it directly.

src_members.name: EccLevelBitsM
src_members.comment: ISO/IEC 18004 Table 25: L=01, M=00, Q=11, H=10. This generator only ever uses M (00).
